_comment: OPTIONAL. Minimal IAM policy for a dedicated frontend-deploy user or GitHub Actions role — lets it sync the S3 bucket and invalidate CloudFront, and nothing else. Use this instead of your AdministratorAccess keys for routine deploys / CI. Replace BUCKET_NAME, ACCOUNT_ID, and DISTRIBUTION_ID. Attach via IAM -> Users (or Roles) -> Add permissions -> Create inline policy -> JSON. See AWS_MIGRATION_GUIDE.md Companion files index.
